Overlay.Layout.Title: Layout mode

Overlay.Layout.Shortcuts: Ctrl+Shift+L closes layout mode · Ctrl+Shift+H hides the overlay

Overlay.Plan.Title: Game plan
Overlay.Plan.BracketTip: Stats come from players in this rating group
Overlay.Plan.PowerTip: Tier S (best) to D, and the average final placement of players who played this comp: 1 is first, lower is better. Core: the comp's key cards you already have.

Overlay.Plan.ShopPlanTip: Uses live button costs (freeze, reroll, upgrade, Dark Gift) and the chosen comp

Overlay.Plan.CompCardsTip: Core: the comp needs it. Add-on: makes it stronger. Cycle: helps on the way, usually not kept.

Overlay.Plan.ChosenTip: Your choice, kept for the next games. Click to clear it: then no comp is targeted until you choose one.
Overlay.Plan.LockTip: Lock keeps this comp as your plan for this game, even if you pick up cards for another one. Click again to unlock and let Hearthpulse choose.
Overlay.Plan.ManualTip: Comps that fit this lobby's tribes, with how players who played them placed. Click one to make it your plan: the tavern and Discover hints then count its cards. Your choice is kept for the next games.
Overlay.Plan.SuggestTip: Hearthpulse suggests a comp: the strongest one for this lobby's tribes, or the one you have already started. The tavern badges then show what to buy for it.
Overlay.Plan.AutoTip: Comps that fit this lobby's tribes. Click one to lock your plan on it for this game.
Overlay.Plan.RowChooseTip: Make this comp your plan (kept for the next games)
Overlay.Plan.RowSwitchTip: Switch your plan to this comp and lock it there

Overlay.Plan.LobbyLock: Comps for this lobby  ·  click to lock one
